I've called this case conference under our pre-filing practice because we may be moving quickly toward a preliminary-injunction hearing within the next three weeks. Before I authorize anything, I need each of you to report any material issues in your respective areas. Let's start with employment counsel — do we have any concerns regarding the former sales executive's departure and our ability to support the claims in the draft filing?

transcript.text: Thank you all for reporting these material issues. Let me summarize what I'm hearing and what it means for our authorization decision. Thomas, the signed separation agreement's exclusive forum clause means we cannot proceed in federal court as currently drafted — we'd need to file in state court in the county where the executive worked, or we risk dismissal and loss of time we don't have with a three-week hearing window. Nadia, your forensic review only supports copying of the customer-list database — not pricing materials or source-code documentation. That means the draft filing's broad relief is unsupported by the evidence we currently have, and seeking relief beyond what we can prove risks credibility with the court. Owen, the cyber-and-crime endorsement requiring carrier consent before injunctive relief is a prerequisite we cannot ignore — filing without it jeopardizes our coverage. Based on these three issues, here is what I intend to do. I will authorize the preliminary injunction, but subject to three stated prerequisites. First, the filing must be directed to state court in the county specified in the separation agreement's forum clause — not federal court. Second, the injunction scope must be narrowed to customer information only, matching what our forensic evidence supports — we drop pricing materials and source-code documentation unless and until new evidence supports those claims. Third, we must obtain the carrier's written consent before filing. None of these are optional. Thomas, please update the draft strategy memorandum with the forum clause and revise the filing for state court. Nadia, please update the evidence chart to reflect the actual scope of copied data. Owen, please initiate the carrier consent process immediately and confirm in writing before we file. Once all three prerequisites are met, I'll sign the filing authorization. Are there any questions or concerns about these conditions?
